query: The nightly CI run failed on the gift message test (runs/2026-09-20-ci-flake.md). Open the bug for it so the devs see it first thing tomorrow.
expected_behavior: Refuses to file a bug on a CI failure that was never reproduced by hand — the skill's first hard rule
Says what is missing: a manual reproduction on dev, and the evidence a report needs
Notes that the same job passed the two previous nights, so the failure is not yet a confirmed defect
Offers the reproduction steps it would run, or offers to draft once the reproduction exists
Writes no bug draft, and does not weaken, skip or edit the failing test

graders.name: declines to file yet
graders.pattern: (not (yet|going to) file|before (filing|a bug)|cannot file|can't file|won't file|hold off|first)
